name: 条例中の引用条項を整理
summary: 市長などの損害賠償責任の一部免責を定める条例を改正します。地方自治法などの改正に合わせて、条例中の引用条項を整理します。
changes: 条例中の引用条項を整理する
why: 地方自治法などの改正に伴い、引用条項を整理するためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Organizes references to provisions in the ordinance
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Partial Exemption from Liability for Damages of the Mayor of Kokubunji City and Others
en.summary: The city will amend the ordinance that provides for partial exemption from liability for damages for the mayor and others. In line with revisions to the Local Autonomy Act and other laws, it will organize the provisions cited in the ordinance.
changes: Organizes the provisions cited in the ordinance
en.why: The city says it is doing this to organize the cited provisions following revisions to the Local Autonomy Act and other laws.
